root.label: Hajja settler raid kills Omar Tubasi

events.label: Hajja settler raid kills Omar Tubasi

slots.name: Hajja injured
slots.sentence: Wafa also reported late on Sunday that Israeli settlers killed Omar Tubasi, 20, and injured three people when they raided and opened fire on the village of Hajja, east of Qalqilya governorate in the occupied West Bank.

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: Elsewhere, settlers stormed Umm al-Khair in the South Hebron Hills on Friday, injuring a child.
